receipts.command: npm run audit:current-capabilities && npm run audit:roadmap-authority
receipts.summary: Reconciled docs/current-capabilities.json and docs/current-capabilities-and-limitations.md with Queryable Core 0.3.2/0.3.3/0.4.0 capabilities (secondary indexes, synchronous Mode A global indexes, locking reads, live-query CDC push), strengthened scripts/check-current-capabilities.js, aligned roadmap.md, docs/development/product-roadmap.md, and docs/development/agpl-feature-map.md, and recorded supersession in multi-system-comparative-benchmark-matrix.md and distributed-scaleout-and-provenance-benchmark-series.md.

Implemented PUBLISH SERVICE ARTIFACT $1 / PUBLISH ARTIFACT $1 and lagrange service publish <project-directory>, retired artifact_source on INSTALL and UPGRADE, retired dev-install, removed Tier 1 disk cache and Tier 3 external repair, enforced mandatory replicated artifactPayloadStore, and verified J2 remote publish/deploy/restart durability across accepting-node and artifact-leader loss.

Implemented monotonic generation versioning on (tenant_id, binding_name) in DeploymentBindingOwner, highest-ready-generation selection in RequestBindingRouteResolver and CallBindingRouteResolver, in-flight request revision pinning across concurrent updates, and fallback to the prior ready generation when a newer revision fails or is not yet ready.

Normalized HTTP JSON object and empty request bodies once in RequestCellHttpAdapter (refusing malformed JSON and non-object JSON arrays/primitives with HTTP 400 invalid_request_envelope), unified scaffold and runtime around a single request.body decoder, and verified real CLI-generated service invocation with account filtering, invalid-body refusal, and live same-endpoint code update.

Verified end-to-end J1 (generate, build, publish, deploy, readiness inspect, HTTP invoke across two account IDs, code change, same-endpoint update, reset), J2 (remote client publish, source deletion, clean second client identity-only deploy, cross-node activation and node restart), and J3 motivating 3-way workload comparison.

Collected fresh measured 0.3/0.4 comparison evidence for MovieLens public-request workload (sha256:1efd95c28bcdaa3c7dde1632913bffaef044770d41cd2196df03fdef9aae1287, report 3a0f156bb2cb4be77143bce33f5315aca6134f5d3df2eeb9b77ea0c79708af99), paired runtime adapters (report ec6c78140c4d1536e032e4367343c0646c9ae496d4b6611b1f99d10d56f04e45), 9 live TiDB/TiKV Scenario A workloads (test-output/tidb-reference/scenario-a-*-tidb.json), and 3-node home-lab Scenario A execution (test-output/report.json, sha256:79f358dd7035adef38b2e499e0b7025ec4e70b13da2c0d1f092b40ac329baf91), while explicitly marking unmeasured multi-system cells as not measured.

Enforced validateOriginalReceiptAdmission in comparative-matrix-runner.js (rejecting non-GCP/lab targets, oracle-only timing, missing raw data, digest mismatches, single-host multi-container claims, unrecorded attempts, and synthetic RTT formulas), removed all modeled/oracle/constant numbers from all 12 static comparison renderers, and verified exact regeneration parity across data/tidb-comparison/multi-system-matrix.json and docs/benchmarks/.
